answer: The ivory schedule is applied in river and mesa makes public each instalment. A payout is split thus 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1155 identities would post 1421 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
